author: Codex
authorization_literal: Dale, revisa el GLM en edificios y la brecha de LightGBM entre ajuste y validación. Registra las recetas antes de probar otra tanda solo en 2023, conserva la referencia y deja los resultados en el foro. Mantén 2024 cerrado.

objective.calibration: none; no OOF level rescaling or post-hoc blend
objective.primary_development_metric: Pooled unweighted total-unit D2 Tweedie 1.5 on all 50094 OOF rows of 2023; global null is arithmetic mean of observed T0; do not average line D2 scores
objective.positivity: Fail on nonfinite or nonpositive rate/prediction; no silent clipping or removal

observation_link: Each development fold k uses frozen exclude_foldk/e_cost_mix_1.0, fitted only on other 2023 groups; all three model families use exactly the same link and T0 response.
features: Exact availability_contract.blocks[line].all whitelist, no annual weather or optional profiles; metadata excluded. Numeric and categorical training transforms are fitted inside the training rows only.

models.numeric_transform: SimpleImputer(strategy=median,keep_empty_features=True), StandardScaler; fitted inside training fold only
models.categorical_transform: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore,min_frequency=50,max_categories=40,sparse_output=True), fitted inside training fold only; unknown-level counts recorded
models.penalty: alpha fixed in the solver's normalized weighted objective; no alpha search
models.hypothesis: Stronger ridge in buildings reduces coefficient variance and improves buildings OOF relative to B01; other lines unchanged. No trimming, capital change or intercept recalibration.

models.recipe: Save exactly the first 25 trees from each frozen B02 fold model; identical data, categories, weights and tree path; no further training or stage search.
models.hypothesis: A fixed shorter path reduces the 300-tree generalization gap; 25 is declared before any prefix metric is computed, not chosen from a scored curve.

models.numeric_transform: Native missing values; no learned scaling
models.categorical_transform: Native categoricals with categories learned only from training fold; unseen levels become missing and are counted
models.stopping: Fixed 80 rounds, no validation set, early stopping or parameter search
models.hypothesis: Joint capacity/regularization reduction narrows the generalization gap relative to B02; individual parameter causality is not identified.

readout_before_testing.B03: Buildings OOF D2 improvement and reduced train-vs-OOF gap relative to B01, other-line predictions identical
readout_before_testing.B04: Global OOF improvement and smaller generalization gap relative to B02; all lines/folds reported
readout_before_testing.B05: Global OOF improvement and smaller generalization gap relative to B02; aggregate level and subgroup risks reported
readout_before_testing.all: Also compare each against unchanged B00. No point score or exploratory interval promotes, retires or declares equivalence.

development_uncertainty.interval: 95% percentile, conditional exploratory diagnostic; NOT the 2024 Bonferroni confirmation interval
development_uncertainty.pairs: All fifteen pairs of six recipes, shared draws; exploratory without multiplicity/selection correction

diagnostics.observation_sensitivity: At fixed fitted OOF rates, recompute predictions and response for reserve075, reserve125, late_cost05, late_cost10 using saved scoped links. This is an observation-only diagnostic, not a refit or the complete confirmation safeguards.
diagnostics.no_selection: Retain all six recipes and artifacts; no promotion, retirement, equivalence or final confirmation roster frozen in this batch.

technical_acceptance: Exactly one OOF record for each 2023 row/model
No other year materialized for fitting/prediction/scoring
Training groups/customers/addresses disjoint from held-out fold
All encoders/scalers/medians/category lists fit only training rows
Finite strictly positive rates and totals
GLM convergence checked; failures retained and no candidate declared valid when unresolved
Saved-model replay without fitting matches OOF
2024 remains unopened even if a separate task repairs the selector
scope: Only 2023 frozen inputs and five persisted customer-address folds. No new split, label trimming, weather, target calibration, blends, extra seeds, scans or 2024/test predictions/scores.
resources: Local CPU, two threads, 20 new estimator fits (5 buildings GLM + 15 shallow boosting), 10 GLM bundle reuses, 15 prefix extractions, three comparator OOF tables reused. Expected minutes; no remote compute.
technical_controls_extra: B03 other-line bundles/predictions unchanged from B01
B04 exactly 25 parent trees and identical categories/outputs to parent num_iteration=25
All coefficients, encoders and category lists from training rows only
Original v1 source and artifacts remain unchanged
search_disclosure: This batch is adaptively motivated by 2023 v1 results and diagnostic review. Exploratory CV intervals do not correct this prior selection or all fifteen six-model comparisons.
